typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	record_count_l as integer (0),
	record_count_u as integer (0)
}
source(output(
		{User__r.IsActive} as boolean,
		{User__r.Id} as string,
		{User__r.FirstName} as string,
		{User__r.LastName} as string,
		{User__r.Email} as string,
		{User__r.Agent_NPN__c} as string,
		{User__r.Phone} as string,
		Active__c as string,
		State_License_Number__c as string,
		State__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['salesforce_license/licensing_raw*']) ~> licenseRaw
source(output(
		IsActive as string,
		Id as string,
		FirstName as string,
		LastName as string,
		Email as string,
		Agent_NPN__c as string,
		Phone as string,
		Department as string,
		NUID__c as string,
		PURL_Account_Type__c as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	wildcardPaths:['salesforce_license/user_raw*']) ~> userRaw
Filter1 select(mapColumn(
		ISACTIVE = IsActive,
		ID = NUID__c,
		FIRSTNAME = FirstName,
		LASTNAME = LastName,
		EMAIL = Email,
		PHONE = Phone,
		Agent_NPN__c,
		State__c,
		State_License_Number__c,
		Active__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select1
userRaw, licenseRaw join(Id == {User__r.Id},
	joinType:'left',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'auto')~> Join2
Join2 filter(lower(PURL_Account_Type__c) =='kpif' || lower(PURL_Account_Type__c) =='universal tier 2') ~> Filter1
Join2 filter(lower(PURL_Account_Type__c) =='medicare' || lower(PURL_Account_Type__c) =='universal tier 2') ~> Filter2
Filter2 select(mapColumn(
		ISACTIVE = IsActive,
		ID = NUID__c,
		FIRSTNAME = FirstName,
		LASTNAME = LastName,
		EMAIL = Email,
		PHONE = Phone,
		Agent_NPN__c,
		State__c,
		State_License_Number__c,
		Active__c
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select2
Select1 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	input(
		{Id|Contact__r.Customer_Id__c|Contact__r.Id|Contact__r.Type__c|Preferred_Spoken_Language__c|OTN__c|Contact__r.FirstName|Contact__r.middle_initial__c|Contact__r.LastName|Contact__r.OtherStreet|Contact__r.OtherCity|Contact__r.OtherState|Contact__r.OtherPostalCode|Contact__r.Birthdate|Contact__r.HomePhone|Contact__r.MailingStreet|Contact__r.MailingCity|Contact__r.MailingState|Contact__r.MailingPostalCode|Agent_NPN__c|Agent_Lic_State__c|Agent_Licensed__c|Owner.Id|Owner.Name|Owner.Phone|Owner.Email|Method__c} as string
	),
	partitionFileNames:[(concat('ob_almsdata_',toString(currentTimestamp(),'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss_'),toString($record_count_l),'.csv'))],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	quoteAll: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> sink1
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	input(
		{Id|Contact__r.Customer_Id__c|Contact__r.Id|Contact__r.Type__c|Preferred_Spoken_Language__c|OTN__c|Contact__r.FirstName|Contact__r.middle_initial__c|Contact__r.LastName|Contact__r.OtherStreet|Contact__r.OtherCity|Contact__r.OtherState|Contact__r.OtherPostalCode|Contact__r.Birthdate|Contact__r.HomePhone|Contact__r.MailingStreet|Contact__r.MailingCity|Contact__r.MailingState|Contact__r.MailingPostalCode|Agent_NPN__c|Agent_Lic_State__c|Agent_Licensed__c|Owner.Id|Owner.Name|Owner.Phone|Owner.Email|Method__c} as string
	),
	partitionFileNames:[(concat('ob_almsdata_medicare_',toString(currentTimestamp(),'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss_'),toString($record_count_l),'.csv'))],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	saveOrder: 2) ~> sink2
